prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of this room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this room, the front view (the establishing view): the camera stands at the centre of the front wall, at eye level, facing the back wall, with a 35mm lens and natural textures. The room layout and furniture placement should exactly match Image 1. The place is completely empty of people: no person, figure, silhouette, mannequin or reflection of a person anywhere, including behind glass, through doorways and in the distance. Location: EXT. CITY ARTERIAL ROAD. A wide, multi-lane contemporary city arterial road at dusk, seen from a raised vantage. Back side: the road runs straight away from the camera to a vanishing point between glass office towers, under a deep blue and orange dusk sky. Left side: a row of tall glass office towers with lit windows above a tree-lined sidewalk and a line of streetlights. Right side: a matching row of towers and streetlights. Front side, behind the camera: the overpass the view is taken from. The lanes are packed with traffic, white headlights coming towards the camera and red tail-lights going away. Light comes from the dusk sky, the streetlamps flickering on along both sides, and the headlights. Show only this place as described: the doors, windows and openings it names lead nowhere new, with no other exit, courtyard, corridor or outdoor view added. Light it with the sources the description names, from their direction, at a neutral daylight white balance so that whites are white; only lamps the description names may glow warm.

Avoid: people or silhouettes, readable text, labels, signs with letters or numbers, logos, watermark.
